title.narrative: 2026 Syria Regional Appeal - Syria - Multi-Purpose Cash Assistance

description.narrative: The Agency will continue to provide this assistance based on a targeted approach, prioritizing refugees assessed as most vulnerable with a higher cash transfer. UNRWA will extend emergency cash assistance to up to 450,000 Palestine refugees, including 170,504 identified as the most vulnerable under UNRWA’s two-tier targeting approach in support of those already present and eligible in Syria, and up to 30,000 Palestine refugees arriving, voluntarily or under adverse circumstances, from outside of Syria in 2025. Those in the most vulnerable category will receive US$ 38.03 per person, per month, while the remaining caseload will be allocated US$ 25.23 per person, per month. As part of its broader commitment to Accountability to Affected Populations (AAP), in 2025, UNRWA will conduct two PDM surveys to evaluate the effectiveness of MPCA and assess refugee satisfaction with this assistance measure. These efforts will be complemented by community meetings to gather feedback, foster dialogue and address concerns.
